metadata.description: Pavel Rykov's agent-skills marketplace for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code CLI and other agents.

plugins.name: rpa-init
plugins.description: Warm up context on a repository: optionally git pull first, then study code, docs and tests, set up the dev environment, run tests, write a short report. No extra brief required.

plugins.name: rpa-gen-rules
plugins.description: Create or refresh agent project rules (Cursor .mdc, Claude Code .claude/rules, Codex .codex hook bridge that auto-attaches Cursor rules by glob). Layered-cake architecture + BDD, with a mandatory Rules Sync step across agent trees. Rules and AGENTS.md in English unless asked otherwise.

plugins.name: rpa-feat
plugins.description: Add a feature strictly by BDD: plan, red tests, green implementation, full suite, docs and examples, linter at the end. Requires a clear feature description.

plugins.name: rpa-bugfix
plugins.description: Fix a bug with a reproduction test first, then the fix, then the full suite, then a short report. Requires a clear bug description.

plugins.name: logika
plugins.description: Classical formal logic from G. Chelpanov's textbook: concepts, judgments, syllogisms, induction, fallacies, laws of thought.

plugins.name: token-cost
plugins.description: Estimate the floor (self-) cost of a self-hosted LLM token: electricity + hardware amortization, measured on the server. Not the market API price.

plugins.name: mikrotik-config-gen
plugins.description: Generate secure MikroTik RouterOS v7 configs from plain language, or review and harden an existing /export. Hardening baseline, four presets, per-model device reference, offline validator.

plugins.name: screenshotting-gui
plugins.description: Capture clean, repeatable screenshots of a GUI desktop app (IDEs, browsers, native apps) on an isolated Xvfb display: drive it with python-Xlib, capture with ImageMagick, annotate with a highlight box, crop or arrow. Never touches the operator's live desktop.

plugins.name: gpu-server-setup
plugins.description: Prepare a Linux server with NVIDIA GPUs for LLM and neural-network workloads: NVIDIA driver + CUDA from the official repo, Docker + NVIDIA Container Toolkit as the mandatory base, staged verification gates, optional compose presets for vLLM, Infinity, OpenWebUI and Ollama (llama.cpp via its official image), and GPU power-limit setup persisted via systemd.

plugins.name: rdp-agent
plugins.description: Drive a remote Windows machine over RDP from an AI agent: the RDP client runs on an isolated Xvfb display, the operator watches the same screen in a VNC window and can take over by hand, the session survives between agent turns, and lock screens are recovered by an NLA reconnect instead of typing the password.

plugins.name: crossreview
plugins.description: Cross-review code with several console code agents at once: Claude Code, Codex, Coddy, Cursor Agent, Devin, OpenCode and others review the same brief in parallel and blind to each other, then the orchestrating agent verifies every finding against the code and decides alone what matters and what to fix. Linux, macOS and Windows; reviewers chosen once per agent, for one project or for all of them.
